## Summary

Describe the user-visible outcome and the reason for the change.

## Validation

List the exact focused regression and other checks that passed.

## Checklist

- [ ] I recorded the focused failure before implementation with `./scripts/change red`.
- [ ] I updated tests and public documentation for the changed behavior.
- [ ] I did not include secrets, private place content, or qualification artifacts.
- [ ] The complete tree has passed `./scripts/change qualify`, or this is a draft awaiting maintainer qualification.
